basic_info.description: Located on a tranquil tree-lined street in coveted Forest Hill, this exceptional residence seamlessly blends architectural character with contemporary living. The heart of this home -- a dramatic Great Room with soaring ceilings, rich hardwood floors, and a wood-burning fireplace framed by custom built-ins -- floods with natural light from expansive windows overlooking lush greenery. The adjacent chef's kitchen boasts professional Viking appliances, stone countertops, and an island perfect for gathering. The main level offers 3 generously-sized bedrooms and 2 designer baths. The primary suite features a thoughtfully renovated bathroom with custom hex-tile detailing and direct access to a serene, mature garden. Additionally find versatile spaces ideal for today's lifestyle: a media room, game area, additional bedroom, full bath, & a private office/5th bedroom -- perfect for working from home or multi-generational living. Indoor/outdoor flow is seamless with multiple access points to the inviting deck and garden retreat. Two-car parking in the pristine garage + additional parking in the driveway. Prime location near Forest Hill Muni, West Portal & Irving Street shops, cafes, parks, and top schools. A rare opportunity in one of San Francisco's most distinguished neighborhoods.
